text_block_list.text:
The first three years of every racer's
career are
incredibly important. During
those years, Rice
Shower has achieved
some incredible feats.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: People all over have praised her efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...An a-award ceremony?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
That's right! You did help make the
Takarazuka
Kinen happen, after all.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
So many people in the URA want to
celebrate you
by holding a ceremony in
your honor.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: I-I'm happy to hear it, but...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
By all means, please grace them with
your
presence.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
The staff from the Hanshin and Kyoto

Racecourses are looking forward to
seeing you
there as well.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
Oh... They're the ones who did
everything in their
power when I asked
for help.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I have to thank them in
person.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
The next day, Райс Шоуэр and I visit the
Hanshin
Racecourse together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Th-there are so many people... And it's
not even a
raceday…
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Wow, look, it's Rice! Oooh, she's so
cute!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: Rice! It's so great to see you!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: Huh?! What?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Long time no see, you two!
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
I-it's nice to see you again! But, um...
what's going
on?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Oh this? Well, the original plan was just
a
celebration with the staff, but...
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text: Rice! Look over here!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there were lots of fans
that also
wanted to see you.
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text: Huh?! L-love?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. So we changed our plans
and pulled
a few strings.
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
As a result, the award ceremony is now
open to
the general public.
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
I see... Then all these people... came to
see me?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
That's right... By the way, may we ask
you to do
what you weren't able to do
last time?
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
Here, in front of all the people excited
to see
you?
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text: ...Yes, of course!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Uh, um... Hi, everyone.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: I'm Ri—
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Screeeeech!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: H-haha... sorry. The mic is kind of...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I hope I didn't hurt your ears.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Don't worry! We're okay!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Th-thank you. Ummm, well...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I would like to thank everyone for
coming here to
see me today.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen anything like this before,
and... I'm
so happy.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: So, so happy... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Don't cry!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: R-right! Sorry... I won't cry.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Because today, I want to be able to look
you all
in the eye while I talk to you.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
...I used to be really lonely. I was stuck
cowering
in a dark place, always hiding
away.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: But... I'm not alone anymore.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
It's because of all of you that I'm able to
stand
here.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
You brought me light, and gave me a
place to
belong to...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We'll now move on to presenting the
certificate
of our gratitude as well as the
award. Please turn
your attention to the
screen!
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text: Hi, everyone! Hi, Rice!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: ...Greetings.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: Come on, Bourbon! Don't be shy!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I have analyzed the script thoroughly.
You are the
only one who is supposed to
speak.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: It's fiiine! Don't worry about the script!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, there's tons of Rice fans over
here too!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Data indicates plans for a
commemorative plaque
are currently
underway as well.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! Don't ruin the surprise,
Bourbon!
Shhh! Shhh!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Broadcast time has elapsed. Back to you,

Hanshin.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: What, time's up?! Bye-bye, Rice!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I'm sorry... I said that I wouldn't
cry, but...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Miss Rice, do you have anything you'd
like to
add?
text_block_list.name: Staff A

text_block_list.text:
Everyone... I'm going to continue
working hard,
so...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Please... please continue to support me!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: On the bus home...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yawn... That was fun... I didn't think today would be so memorable.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother. Because of
you...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister. Because of you...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: I could...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah... Sniff...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
...I was always so useless, but now I've
become a
blue rose.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Unlike the book, I know bad things will
still
probably happen sometimes.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
But this blue rose's wish is to keep
blooming and
to bring happiness to
everyone, forever and ever.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
...Alongside my favorite person in the
whole wide
world.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр
